# DAL (Device Abstraction Layer) Component CMake
#
# P2-1 (2026-07-06): per-driver compile-time pruning via WINK_USE_XXX options.
# ADR-0039: top-level may call wink_dal_apply_pruning() BEFORE add_subdirectory(dal).
# ADR-0046: driver universe SSOT = tools/codegen/drivers/; options + extras from
#           list_drivers.py --cmake --mode=source (data + wink_dal_apply_extra_cmake).
#
# Adding a standard driver: implement dal_*.{h,c} + drivers/<type>.py only �?
# do not edit this file's driver list.
add_library(dal STATIC)

if(NOT WINK_MICRO_OS_ROOT)
    get_filename_component(WINK_MICRO_OS_ROOT
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
endif()
include(${WINK_MICRO_OS_ROOT}/cmake/wink_tools.cmake)
if(NOT Python3_EXECUTABLE)
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
endif()

set(_WINK_DAL_GEN "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated_drivers.cmake")
execute_process(
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${WINK_TOOLS_ROOT}/tools/codegen/list_drivers.py
            --cmake --mode=source
    OUTPUT_FILE "${_WINK_DAL_GEN}"
    RESULT_VARIABLE _wink_list_drivers_rc
    ERROR_VARIABLE _wink_list_drivers_err
)
if(NOT _wink_list_drivers_rc EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "list_drivers.py failed (rc=${_wink_list_drivers_rc}): "
        "${_wink_list_drivers_err}")
endif()
include("${_WINK_DAL_GEN}")

file(GLOB _wink_driver_plugins CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
     ${WINK_TOOLS_ROOT}/tools/codegen/drivers/*.py)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${_wink_driver_plugins})

# ── Public include paths (always exposed for WINK_UNAVAILABLE_MSG stubs) ──
# When extending DriverCategory, update this list (ADR-0046).
target_include_directories(dal PUBLIC
    include
    include/input
    include/output
    include/actuator
    include/display
    include/sensor
    include/communication
    include/storage
)

target_include_directories(dal PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../runtime/include
)

target_link_libraries(dal PUBLIC pal)

# Helper: enable one driver �?.h+.c for IDE indexing + PUBLIC -DWINK_USE_*=1.
function(_wink_dal_enable opt opt_def cat stem)
    if(${opt})
        target_sources(dal PRIVATE
            include/${cat}/dal_${stem}.h
            src/${cat}/dal_${stem}.c
        )
        target_compile_definitions(dal PUBLIC ${opt_def}=1)
    endif()
endfunction()

foreach(_drv IN LISTS WINK_KNOWN_DRIVERS)
    _wink_dal_enable(
        WINK_USE_${_drv}
        WINK_USE_${_drv}
        ${WINK_DAL_${_drv}_CATEGORY}
        ${WINK_DAL_${_drv}_STEM}
    )
endforeach()

# IDE-only: font internal header when SSD1306 is enabled (not a compile TU).
if(WINK_USE_SSD1306)
    target_sources(dal PRIVATE src/display/dal_ssd1306_font_internal.h)
endif()

set(WINK_DAL_TARGET dal)
wink_dal_apply_extra_cmake()
